versions.changelog:
VoiceScope VOC Insight v1.0.0

- Initial release with workflows for customer feedback analysis, including viewpoint extraction & clustering, batch tagging, taxonomy generation/validation, and per-row analyses (sentiment, keywords, summary, scenario, action).
- Supports CSV, Excel (.xlsx/.xlsm), and TXT formats; guides users to confirm columns and taxonomy before analysis.
- Results delivered both online (via direct link) and as local downloads.
- Includes detailed error handling and clear next-step guidance.
- Integrates deeply with the VoiceScope platform, directing users to enhanced online insights (word clouds, dashboards, reports) when applicable.
